Subject: Next steps & MAP: legal timeline and redline ownership (draft attached)

Hi Simone / Rajiv —

Great to meet you both on the discovery call this morning. Quick recap and the next steps I promised: attaching our current MAP draft (MAP-draft-v3.docx) and a clean MSA for your review (Redwood-MSA-clean.pdf).

High-level milestones (proposed):
- 10/16–10/22: Technical & security confirmation (SOC2 artifacts + SSO details) — BlueWave engineering + Redwood infra
- 10/18–10/25: Legal review & redlines (MSA / DPA / SLA) — ownership guidance below
- 10/26–11/03: Final sign-off & DocuSign execution
- Target close: 2026-11-05 (depends on redline turnaround)

MAP milestone: Legal redlines & negotiation responsibilities (current proposal):
- Redwood provides a clean MSA + DPA + suggested SLA language (attached) by EOD 10/16.
- Proposal: BlueWave legal may take the lead on the first-pass redline for the MSA/DPA (if preferred). Alternatively, Redwood can provide a marked-up MSA first — please confirm which you prefer.
- Requested turnaround: 5 business days for first-pass redlines from whichever side takes ownership. If both exchange concurrently, we'll treat each set as a counterparty proposal and aim for 2 business days for Redwood to respond to substantive commercial redlines.

Dependencies we discussed:
- SOC2 Type II report (we can share current evidence package once NDA is in place)
- SSO/SAML details and data retention knobs for PHI-adjacent data
- Clarify SLA uptime & remediation windows (we've proposed standard tiers in the attached SLA)

Ask: Please confirm who on your side will own the first redline (MSA vs DPA vs SLA) and a realistic turnaround window. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min legal sync next week (suggested times: 10/19 10:00–11:00 PT or 10/20 14:00–15:00 PT).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com)

Attachments:
- MAP-draft-v3.docx (outline with milestones/responsibilities)
- Redwood-MSA-clean.pdf (clean MSA + SLA appendix)

From: Simone Green <simone.green@bluewavehealth.com>

Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & MAP: legal timeline and redline ownership (draft attached)

Thanks Karthik — useful recap and the attachments are helpful. A couple quick notes from our side: 

1) BlueWave Legal preference: We'd generally prefer to own the first-pass redline on the MSA and DPA (it helps us consolidate internal comments). Expecting to deliver those redlines within 7 business days (aiming for 10/25).

2) SLA: Our procurement team typically wants the vendor to propose the SLA baseline; we will then flag any deviations. Can you confirm Redwood is comfortable owning the initial SLA language?

3) Security artifacts: We need clarification on SSO (SAML vs OIDC), session retention defaults, and whether any PHI will be stored in cleartext. Can your security team provide brief answers or a 20-min sync?

Let's tentatively schedule the legal sync for 10/20 14:00 PT (that works for me). Rajiv — can you confirm?

Best,
Simone Green
Director of Product | BlueWave Health
(simone.green@bluewavehealth.com)

Internal note — Karthik / Dev,

Thanks for the thread. My recommended approach to keep the timeline intact:

- We send the clean MSA + DPA + SLA (attached) by EOD 10/16 (we already have the files). That's our baseline.
- Since BlueWave prefers to do the first-pass on MSA/DPA, accept that but ask for a firm 5-business-day turnaround (we should push from 7 → 5).
- Redwood to own the SLA baseline and any service-level / remediation text. Proposed Redwood turnaround on SLA redlines: 3 business days.
- If BlueWave returns extensive commercial redlines, escalate to legal & AE sync within 48 hours for a joint decision.
- For DPA PHI items: tag those as "high priority" and require specific clause language (data residency, subprocessors) — we should pre-populate acceptable language in the DPA to speed review.

Action items:
- Dev: bundle the clean MSA/DPA/SLA and a one-pager of suggested DPA clauses (deadline: 10/16 EOD).
- Karthik: confirm 10/20 legal sync with Simone & Rajiv and include Redwood legal (Marissa will join).

Marissa

Hi Simone / Rajiv —

Thanks for confirming. Per the thread and Marissa's note, attached are the files we discussed: MAP-draft-v3.docx and Redwood-MSA-clean.pdf. Summary of the legal milestone and explicit turnaround commitments (to lock into the MAP):

Milestone: Legal redlines (MSA / DPA / SLA)
- Owner (MSA): BlueWave Legal (first-pass) — please return redlines within 5 business days from receipt.
- Owner (DPA): BlueWave Legal (first-pass) — please return redlines within 5 business days; we've pre-filled acceptable subprocessors and data residency language in the attached DPA draft to accelerate this.
- Owner (SLA): Redwood Legal (initial baseline delivered now) — Redwood will respond to SLA redlines within 3 business days.

Turnaround dates (calendar):
- Redwood delivered clean MSA/DPA/SLA: 2026-10-16 (delivered).
- BlueWave first-pass redlines due: 2026-10-23 (5 business days).
- Redwood response to redlines (if needed): within 2 business days for commercial bullets, 3 business days for SLA language.
- Target contract execution (DocuSign): 2026-11-05 (contingent on timely redlines).

Dependencies / Risks:
- If SOC2 evidence or specific SSO details are delayed beyond 10/22, it will push the review window and may move target close by >1 week.
- Extensive commercial concessions (pricing, indemnity) may require approval cycles and extend beyond our standard turnaround. We'll flag these early.

Next steps:
- Simone / Rajiv: confirm 10/20 14:00 PT for a 30-min legal sync (we will send calendar invite).

Links & references:
